STONE PAINT Granite Effect.name: STONE PAINT Granite Effect
STONE PAINT Granite Effect.description: Textured coating providing a natural stone look and durability for surfaces.
STONE PAINT Granite Effect.more_detail:
STONE PAINT Granite Effect is a textured coating designed to give surfaces a natural stone-like appearance. It can be used for both interior and exterior applications, adding durability and aesthetic appeal.

Coverage: [8 to 9 square m /25kg]
Finish: Gloss
Drying Time: ≈ [6 to 10] hours.
Re-coat: ≈ [3 to 4 hours]
Application: using plastic or steel trowel
